verdict.rationale: Undermind's homepage directly claims the core capability: "Get notified whenever relevant papers are published," which matches standing alerts that surface new sources. The support rests on a single marketing line with no setup or configuration documentation and no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of how standing searches or alerts are configured (topics, frequency, delivery channel), evidence that alerts tie to saved searches or workspaces, independent or user confirmation that notifications work in practice.
